gloss: to come untied; to come undone

definitions.gloss: to come untied; to come undone; to unravel
definitions.explanation: For something that was tied, knotted, or bound to become loose and come apart on its own.
For tension, a stiff expression, or a guarded attitude to ease and become relaxed. Used figuratively.

examples.japanese: リボンの{結|むす}び{目|め}が{解|ほど}けてしまった。
examples.english: The knot in the ribbon came undone.

examples.japanese: マフラーの{編|あ}み{目|め}が{一|ひと}つ{解|ほど}けている。
examples.english: One stitch in the scarf has come unraveled.

examples.japanese: {緊張|きんちょう}が{解|ほど}けた。
{彼|かれ}の{表情|ひょうじょう}がようやく{解|ほど}けた。
{話|はなし}をするうちに{固|かた}い{雰囲気|ふんいき}が{解|ほど}けてきた。
examples.english: As we talked, the stiff atmosphere gradually relaxed.

notes: Intransitive verb. The transitive counterpart is {解|ほど}く (to untie, to undo). Note that {解|と}ける (also written with the same kanji) is a separate word meaning to be solved or to melt. Collocations: {靴|くつ}ひもが{解|ほど}ける (shoelace comes untied), {結|むす}び{目|め}が{解|ほど}ける (knot comes undone), {緊張|きんちょう}が{解|ほど}ける (tension eases), {表情|ひょうじょう}が{解|ほど}ける (expression softens).
